submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I tested three chemically different regions. Index 11 is V-rich and BiVO4-like with about 24% Cu, and it gave the highest photocurrent: 1.98e-5 A. The Cu-V-rich region (index 64) gave zero. The Bi:V≈1:1 low-Cu point (index 0) gave 1.0e-5 A.
